scope: Clearer web controls, working page buttons, and quicker navigation.

topics.title: Use buttons to move through a website
details: Activate a button with Enter, Space, or "Activate current button". The website handles Next and other buttons using its own checks. Companion announces loading and reads required-field messages. "Review and submit form" still lets you ask for a spoken review.

topics.title: Hear buttons and fields while reading a page
details: Arrow reading now names buttons and form fields and says what type they are. Pictures used as buttons are announced as buttons. Checkboxes include their state. Passwords stay private.

topics.title: Resume your page sooner
details: Turn on Keep browser window open to keep a page. Resume where you left off then comes first in the web browser menu.

topics.title: Move without waiting for old speech
details: Say Next or Previous to stop old speech and move. Replies use a local voice to start sooner. Key presses also stop online speech that is still being made. Page checks spend less time waiting, so the app can check your input sooner.
